tips.text: Check the bounty rotation timer before you load in; only Rotation B can drop Nepheri.
Complete the bonus objective on every stage.
Run whichever hub you clear faster; the drop rates match at Cetus and Fortuna.
Bring a credit Blessing or Prosperous Retriever; the collect 1,000 credits stage drags because few enemies spawn.
Fold these runs into a Caliban farm instead of treating them as a dedicated grind; his parts drop from the other rotations.
Expect many non-drops even on a Rotation B run; 600 Endo fills about 47% of the table.
There is no pity system, so bad luck can run to several times the 8-run average.
Expect one or two Rotation B windows if RNG behaves, spread over a few days if it does not.
